findings.statement: An agent cannot run the standardized command surface literally because 7 of 7 framework verbs are not defined on any runner (format, format:check, lint, typecheck, test, check, security).

remediation.summary: Define every verb (format, format:check, lint, typecheck, test, check, security) as a script/target so an agent never has to invent a command.

findings.statement: An agent cannot run one gate that composes the read-only verbs because no runner defines a check verb.

remediation.summary: Define check as format-check, then typecheck, then test.

findings.statement: An agent cannot install identical dependencies on every run because the jvm project has no lockfile (gradle.lockfile), so a fresh install resolves whatever versions are current.

remediation.summary: Generate the lockfile with the project's package manager and commit it.

findings.statement: An agent cannot prepare the environment non-interactively because no devcontainer, compose file, Dockerfile, setup target/script, or documented install command exists.

remediation.summary: Add a committed setup path (a devcontainer, compose file, or a documented install command in README.md) that runs with no prompts.

findings.statement: An agent cannot know every variable the code needs before running it because 4 referenced key(s) are absent from any committed example file: GREEN, NC, RED, YELLOW.

remediation.summary: Add the missing keys to .env.example (values redacted) so the environment can be provisioned without reading the source.

findings.statement: An agent cannot know where permanent and scratch documentation live because AGENTS.md does not name docs/STYLE_GUIDE.md, artefacts/.

remediation.summary: Name docs/ as the canonical home for permanent knowledge, docs/STYLE_GUIDE.md as the authoring rules, and artefacts/ as off-limits scratch.

findings.statement: An agent cannot keep code and its documentation in step because no definition-of-done sentence ties a documentation trigger to the same change set.

remediation.summary: State that a change altering a public interface, observable behaviour, architecture, a check's semantics or an ADR updates the affected docs and the ADR index in the same change set.

findings.statement: An agent cannot use the project's own commands instead of inventing them because not named: format:check, lint, typecheck, check; not resolved: format, format:check, lint, typecheck, test, check, security.

remediation.summary: List all seven verbs in AGENTS.md and define each on one runner so the instruction and the manifest agree.

findings.statement: An agent cannot learn where code may live and what may cross a boundary because no boundary rule references a path that exists in this repository.

remediation.summary: State at least two boundaries as rules naming real paths — for example where application code lives and where tests live.

findings.statement: An agent cannot rely on an explicit do-not list because AGENTS.md has no prohibitions section.

remediation.summary: Add an explicit prohibitions section covering tests, generated files, the default branch and secrets.

findings.statement: An agent cannot know which instruction file is authoritative because 1 vendor-specific instruction files exist alongside the canonical one (CONVENTIONS.md).

remediation.summary: Keep AGENTS.md canonical; reduce each vendor file to a pointer at it, or delete it if the harness reads AGENTS.md natively.

findings.statement: An agent cannot know which branch to work on and whether it may cut a release because the branch model is stated but nothing says whether an agent may tag or release.

remediation.summary: State the branches that exist (for example main and dev) and whether an agent may tag or publish a release.

findings.statement: An agent cannot trust that the referenced rules are actually loaded because the instruction file defers its content to CONVENTIONS.md and no harness configuration names that file, so loading depends on the agent choosing to follow the pointer.

remediation.summary: Inline the rules that must always apply, or name the referenced file in each harness's config (aider read:, opencode.json instructions, Codex model_instructions_file).

findings.statement: An agent cannot distinguish pre-existing debt from new debt because no baseline or suppression artifact is committed.

remediation.summary: Commit a baseline/suppression artifact, or document the equivalent mechanism in `AGENTS.md`.

findings.statement: An agent cannot state how many violations exist today because no violation-counting tooling, budget or artifact is configured.

remediation.summary: Add linters/type-checkers/security scanners and commit the count they produce, so debt is measured rather than guessed.

findings.statement: An agent cannot stop the violation count from growing because no baseline, budget or comparison step exists, so the count is not guarded.

remediation.summary: Once a baseline exists, wire a comparison step (the audit's own `--baseline REPORT.JSON` is the reference pattern) so new findings fail the build.

findings.statement: An agent cannot know when coverage drops below an agreed floor because no coverage threshold is configured in the test runner.

remediation.summary: Configure a coverage floor for the test runner so a drop fails the gate.

findings.statement: An agent cannot find the project's documentation because no docs/ directory exists in the repository.

remediation.summary: Create docs/ as the canonical home for permanent knowledge, with docs/STYLE_GUIDE.md holding the authoring rules.

findings.statement: An agent cannot find the canonical authoring rules for documentation because docs/STYLE_GUIDE.md does not exist.

remediation.summary: Create docs/STYLE_GUIDE.md and name it from the instruction file so writers have one set of authoring rules.

findings.statement: An agent cannot find where execution begins because the jvm project declares no entry point (main, bin, __main__, Application or func main).

remediation.summary: Declare the entry point in the manifest (package.json main/bin, pyproject scripts, a Gradle main class) or name the executable file so an agent can tell live code from dead code.

findings.statement: An agent cannot trust that secret shapes cannot be committed because ignore rules do not cover ssh private key, PFX, keystore, certificate (.crt), certificate (.cer), AWS credentials.

remediation.summary: Add the missing shapes to .gitignore — for example `.env.*`, `*.pem`, `*.key`, `*.p12`, `*.pfx`, `*.keystore`, `id_rsa*`, `*.crt`, `*.cer`, `.aws/*`.

findings.statement: An agent cannot format a change set the same way every time because no formatter is configured and no format verb is defined.

remediation.summary: Add a formatter config and a format write verb (prettier, black, ruff format, …).

findings.statement: An agent cannot catch lint regressions before they land because no linter is configured and no lint verb is defined.

remediation.summary: Add a linter config and a lint read-only verb (eslint, ruff, flake8, golangci-lint, …).

findings.statement: An agent cannot know whether a dependency carries a known vulnerability because no resolvable verb runs a dependency-audit check.

remediation.summary: Add a dependency-audit verb (npm audit, pip-audit, osv-scanner, cargo audit, govulncheck, snyk).

findings.statement: An agent cannot rely on local hooks to run before a commit because no hook manager is configured.

remediation.summary: Adopt a hook manager (pre-commit, lefthook, husky) and wire it so checks run before a commit rather than only in CI.

findings.statement: An agent cannot run the suite by name because test files exist but no runner exposes a test verb.

remediation.summary: Define a test verb on the runner (for example `npm test`, a Makefile `test` target, or `pytest`) so the suite is reachable without inventing a command.

findings.statement: An agent cannot run one test or a subset without the whole suite because none of the entry documents shows a single-test or subset invocation (scope: AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md).

remediation.summary: Document a fast path (for example `pytest -k <name>`, `npm test -- <name>`, or `go test -run <name>`) in a fenced shell block.

findings.statement: An agent cannot assume every harness on the team sees the project rules because 21 of 28 known harnesses reach an instruction file; Amazon Q Developer, Anthropic Claude Code, Continue, Google Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, Replit Agent, Void reach nothing.

remediation.summary: Either state the supported harnesses in AGENTS.md, or add the vendor pointer files for the harnesses in use.

findings.statement: An agent cannot find the decisions of record because no ADR directory (docs/architecture/adrs/ or docs/adr/) exists.

remediation.summary: Add docs/architecture/adrs/ with NNNN-short-title.md files and a README index that lists them.

findings.statement: An agent cannot know who owns a path before changing it because no CODEOWNERS file exists at the root, under .github/, or under docs/.

remediation.summary: Add .github/CODEOWNERS mapping paths to owners so review routing is machine-readable.

findings.statement: An agent cannot file a change with the information reviewers need because no .github/pull_request_template file exists.

remediation.summary: Add .github/pull_request_template.md describing what a good change records.

findings.statement: An agent cannot report a bug or request in a structured way because no .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE entry exists.

remediation.summary: Add at least one file under .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ (a bug report and a feature request are a good start).

findings.statement: An agent cannot report a vulnerability responsibly because no SECURITY document exists at the root, under .github/, or under docs/.

remediation.summary: Add SECURITY.md with a private disclosure channel and a response expectation.

findings.statement: An agent cannot see what changed between two versions because no CHANGELOG (or CHANGES/HISTORY) document exists.

remediation.summary: Add CHANGELOG.md and record notable changes under a version heading.

findings.statement: An agent cannot know how a release is cut because no text or markdown document describing the release process exists.

remediation.summary: Add docs/releasing.md (or RELEASE.md) describing how a version is cut and published.

findings.statement: An agent cannot keep dependencies patched without manual sweeps because no Dependabot or Renovate configuration exists.

remediation.summary: Add .github/dependabot.yml (or renovate.json) with an update schedule.

findings.statement: An agent cannot reproduce the protected-branch rules as code because the github provider is detected but no branch-protection configuration exists.

remediation.summary: Declare branch protection in code (a Terraform resource or .github/branch-protection) so it is reviewed like any other change.

findings.statement: An agent cannot orient itself from a map instead of exploring blindly because no docs/architecture/, ADR directory or diagram exists.

remediation.summary: Add a short architecture page (with a diagram) so an agent can orient before it explores.

findings.statement: An agent cannot rely on a consistent commit-message convention because no commitlint config, commit-msg hook, or equivalent exists.

remediation.summary: Add a commitlint config or a commit-msg hook so commit messages follow one convention.

findings.statement: An agent cannot see how much of the code the suite actually covers because no coverage configuration or coverage-invoking command is present.

remediation.summary: Configure coverage for the test runner (a `coverage` block, `.coveragerc`/`.nycrc`, `--coverage`/`--cov`, or `go test -cover`).
